concerns.text: T103 claims its output 'conform[s] to specs/.../contracts/interaction_context.schema.yaml field names' but specifies columns 'smiles,bit_index,matched_substructure,interaction_strength', omitting ALL FOUR required schema fields (bit_i, bit_j, substructure_desc, context_type). The deliverable falls short of the contract it claims to satisfy — a semantic weakening of the FR-007/plan-T029 deliverable. Fix the CSV schema or drop the conformance claim.

T101 depends on 'baseline_test_predictions.csv from completed T014.5 (already present)' and the completed list marks T014.5 done — but plan T014.5's own deliverable was baseline_residuals.png, the exact artifact the verifier rejected (T015). The tasks file simultaneously treats T014.5 as complete and re-does its deliverable in T101; the dependency chain is internally contradictory and unverifiable.

T106's inventory asserts 'statistical_test_report.md' and 'validation_audit.md', but plan T021.1 specifies 'statistical_report.md' and plan T057 promises 'validation_audit.pdf'. The inventory check will fail against plan-produced files (or silently bless differently-named artifacts), weakening the reproducibility verification (NFR-004). Canonicalize filenames.

Plan T019.1 and the data model require fingerprints persisted as data/processed/*.npy (memory-mapped per the plan's memory guard), but tasks.md's completed list and T102 read 'data/processed/{full,train,test}_fingerprints.csv'. The completed work contradicts the plan's storage contract and its lazy-loading memory-mitigation claim; either reconcile the plan or record the format change explicitly.
T105's dependency line cites 'completed T030.2/T009 artifacts' but no T009 exists in plan.md or tasks.md — dangling, unverifiable dependency reference.

T107 (paper/methods_results.md + paper-stage handoff) traces to no FR/NFR in spec.md and no plan task. The handoff framing is legitimate stage-ownership, but the task should be recorded as plan-authorized scope (e.g., a plan addendum) rather than appearing only in the task list.

Plan records checksums in standalone 'state/artifact_hashes.yaml' while the constitution requires them in the project's state/projects/PROJ-324-...yaml artifact_hashes map. T106's verification pass should assert the constitution-mandated location; as written neither the plan nor tasks enforce it.
